title: Product & UI Overhaul — Pricing, Features, Web App
description: Complete product redesign: 5-tier pricing model, feature packaging for 1003 engines, à la carte add-ons, new web UI with dark industrial theme, feature gating, Stripe integration, and dashboard pages for all 67 dispatchers.

units.title: Product Catalog & Feature Registry
units.description: Create a product catalog that maps every engine/dispatcher/action to a pricing tier and feature flag. This is the source of truth for what each tier gets.
acceptance_criteria: Every dispatcher action mapped to a tier
Feature flag system: checkAccess(userId, action) → boolean
Usage metering types: per-calculation, unlimited, or daily-limit

units.title: Design System — Extract & Modernize
units.description: Extract design tokens from v8.89 monolith, modernize into Tailwind config. Dark industrial theme with PRISM brand identity.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.ts with PRISM colors (dark bg, blue primary, green success, amber warning, purple pro)
Component library: Button, Card, Badge, Input, Select, Tabs, Modal, Table, Chart
Tier badge components (Free=gray, Machinist=blue, Programmer=green, Engineer=purple, Enterprise=amber)
Lock overlay component for gated features

units.title: App Shell — Navigation & Layout
units.description: New app shell with sidebar navigation, user menu, tier indicator, search, and responsive layout. Groups 67 dispatchers into logical categories.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar with collapsible categories: Machining, Programming, Engineering, Quality, Business, Machine, Admin
Each category lists its feature pages with tier badges
Top bar: search, notifications, user avatar, tier badge

units.title: Landing Page & Pricing Page
units.description: Public-facing landing page with product overview, feature comparison, and pricing table. Stripe checkout integration.
acceptance_criteria: Hero section with PRISM branding and value prop
Feature grid showing key capabilities by tier
Pricing table with 5 tiers + toggle annual/monthly
CTA buttons linking to Stripe checkout
Social proof section (metrics: 1003 engines, 86K tools, 910 machines)

units.title: Dashboard — Home Page
units.description: User dashboard showing recent calculations, usage stats, quick actions, and featured tools for their tier.
acceptance_criteria: Quick action cards: Speed/Feed, Quote, Simulate, Program

units.title: Speed & Feed Calculator Page
units.description: Flagship calculator page — the most-used feature. Full SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine UI with material/tool/machine selection, results display, and recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Material selector with 2957 materials (searchable, grouped by ISO)
Tool selector with 86K tools (searchable by manufacturer/type/diameter)
Machine selector with 910 machines (searchable by manufacturer)
Operation type selector (milling, turning, drilling, etc.)
Real-time results: speed, feed, DOC, WOC, power, force, MRR

units.title: CNC Programming Suite
units.description: Combined page for G-code tools: program assembly, post-processing, simulation, validation, auto speed/feed.
acceptance_criteria: Tier gating: Programmer+ for full features

units.title: Quoting & Estimation Suite
units.description: Full quoting pipeline: part analysis, cycle time, material cost, tooling cost, secondary ops, price breaks.
acceptance_criteria: Part geometry input (dimensions or file upload placeholder)
Tier gating: Machinist+ basic, Engineer+ full

units.title: Feasibility & Process Planning
units.description: MF Track UI — feasibility check, sequence validation, workholding analysis, rigidity checks.
acceptance_criteria: Feasibility check results: accessibility, workholding, rigidity, force, sequence

units.title: Engineering Calculators Hub
units.description: Hub page linking to all engineering calculator categories: mechanical design, thermal, vibration, forming, welding, etc.
acceptance_criteria: Category cards with icons and action counts
Mechanical Design (51 actions): gears, bearings, springs, bolts
Thermal & Fluid (35 actions): heat exchangers, pumps, piping
Vibration (16 actions): stability lobes, chatter, modal
CNC Operations (32 actions): facing, slotting, threading
Machine Setup (25 actions): spindle, balancing, RTCP
Each category page with tabbed calculator interface

units.title: Tool & Machine Database Pages
units.description: Browsable databases for tools, machines, and materials with search, filter, and detail views.
acceptance_criteria: Tool catalog browser: 86K tools, filterable by manufacturer/type/diameter/material
Tool detail card with dimensions, collision data, grades
Machine database browser: 910 machines, filterable by manufacturer/type/specs
Machine detail card with specs, kinematics, controller
Material database browser: 2957 materials, filterable by ISO group
Material detail card with properties, machinability, cutting data
Comparison mode (select 2-3 items to compare side-by-side)

units.title: Settings, Account & Billing
units.description: User settings, account management, subscription billing, usage analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Usage analytics (calculations by type, most-used tools)
Default preferences (units, CAM system, machine, material)
API key management (for API access add-on)
